_comment: Gen-Z hangout spots where stylish young adults dance to a boombox (all adults, no sexual content). Loaded through the Content Service like lessons. Each spot sits on one side of a city block: col/row = the block in the city grid (see docs/GAME_SPEC.md), side = N/S/E/W edge of that block, along = 0..1 position along that edge, inset = metres in from the kerb, rows = lines of dancers, dancers = how many, bpm = music speed. active:false hides a spot. settings: activeDistance = dancers appear when the player is this close; joinRadius = how close Shoumik must be to join; audio.volume 0-1, audio.hearDistance in metres; dancerArchetypes = who dances (names from data/pedestrians.json, with weights); clapChance = share of dancers who just clap along.
